Welcome to the Finology Academy of Mutual Funds!
In this fourth episode, we are decoding every single equity fund category in the market so you know how each one operates and which ones actually fit your financial goals.
Key concepts explained in this episode:
• What are SEBI’s strict market capitalization rules for classifying Large Cap, Mid Cap, and Small Cap companies?
• How do Large Cap, Mid Cap, and Small Cap funds differ in terms of stability, growth potential, and market fall risk?
